modalities.evidence: For structural images a 3D MP2RAGE29 sequence was used
functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) data acquired at rest
measures of mood, sustained attention, blood pressure, respiration, pulse
the content of self-generated thoughts (mind wandering)

output.population: 22 participants scanned during two sessions spaced one week apart
output.summary: High-resolution 7-Tesla resting-state fMRI test-retest data from two sessions one week apart, with whole-brain and prefrontal scans plus mood, attention, blood pressure, respiration, pulse and mind-wandering measures, and the experimental protocol.
